content.content: The read yields the document whole: the node document's bytes as they stand at the owning change — the whole document, never a part of it.
content.rationale: A node document is one JSON document (D1c, kpovwvyw), so a read that yielded only part of it would hand the caller a torn document to parse; reading whole makes the read the document's bytes, which is what checking (S2-validate, ooyrrwlq) and rendering (D16a) take as their input. What a missing or unreadable document reads as is the next layer's, not this node's.
